Honest answer: I can't promise a sale price will still be there next week. Sale prices run while they run, and I can't hold or reinstate one.

What I can say is the sale is live right now, and Apple Pay isn't the only way in. Checkout also takes card, PayPal, Shop Pay and Google Pay, so you could buy today on an existing card rather than wait on the new one.

Which two are you after, the DC06 ($379.99) and the Thor P2 ($379)? I'll build the cart.
